articles.title: BNB Chain details new layer-1 for trading, private finance and AI
articles.snippet: The proposed network will operate alongside BNB Smart Chain and retain BNB as its native token, with a public testnet targeted for the first quarter of 2027.

articles.title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
articles.snippet: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.

articles.title: Before the Sell-Off, AI Stocks Showed Dot-Com-Level Bubble Signals: Study
articles.snippet: A study of 170 years of financial journalism suggests AI stocks rivaled dot-com bubble levels, but estimates vary.

articles.title: OpenAI Fixes ChatGPT Billing Error, Promises to Make it 40% Worse
articles.snippet: OpenAI says a billing mistake made its new AI models cheaper to use than intended. Subscribers will now burn through their allowances faster, but get a free one-time usage reset.

articles.title: The 1Password Breach Didn’t Touch Your Vault. The Phishing Emails Might
articles.snippet: An attacker compromised an employee’s GitHub account to reach 1Password’s backend and copy customer names and emails, but the company says vault contents, encryption keys and your Secret Key were never exposed.
